description: This file is a shell script configuring and managing a network protocol named 'directip'. It includes functions for initializing configuration, setting up and tearing down the protocol, and interacting with a device via gcom commands. It is specific to a particular hardware and network setup within a larger project.

methods.name: proto_directip_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration options for the directip protocol, adding string configuration parameters.

methods.name: proto_directip_setup
methods.description: Sets up the directip protocol by configuring the device, verifying the device and network interface, handling SIM PIN, and starting DHCP and DHCPv6.

methods.name: proto_directip_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the directip protocol, stopping the connection and updating network status.
